name: estate-planning-document-assembler
description: Estate Planning Document Assembler — Claude Desktop plugin that populates a basic will, healthcare power of attorney, financial power of attorney, and HIPAA authorization from one intake pass for solo and small-firm estate planning attorneys

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run pack && npm run checksum
scripts.release: npm run build && gh release create v$npm_package_version $npm_package_name-v$npm_package_version.zip $npm_package_name-v$npm_package_version.zip.sha256 --title "v$npm_package_version" --notes-file RELEASE.md
